info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Banking Channel Specific Atm Network Managements-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Channel ATM Network Management API allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding specific ATM networks managed under various banking channels. This endpoint facilitates access to key resources such as ATM locations, operational statuses, and channel-specific configurations. It is essential for financial institutions, developers, and third-party service providers who require insights into ATM network management to improve service delivery and enhance customer experiences. Utilize this API to monitor and manage ATM networks efficiently, ensuring optimal performance and availability for users.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details about the ATM network management specific to channels, providing insights into network performance, availability, and configuration.

requestBody.description: Request body for obtaining ATM network management information specific to a particular channel. This request is critical for retrieving the operational status and configurations within the ATM network, allowing the client to tailor its interactions based on the channel's parameters.
